source.quote: Eversolo's own specification table for the DAC-Z10, read 2026-11-24. DAC: « Left Channel: AK4191+AK4499 », « Right Channel: AK4191+AK4499 ». « Native Support » « DSD 512 » « PCM 768kHz/32Bit ». « USB Audio In » « DSD512 Native » « PCM 768KHz/32Bit ». « Optical / Coaxial » « PCM 192KHz/24Bit » « DSD64 Dop ». « 8-Mode IIS Digital Audio Input ». Bluetooth Audio Input: « Qualcomm QCC5125 Bluetooth module, Bluetooth version: BT5.0; supports SBC/AAC Bluetooth audio protocols ».

facts.chip: DUAL MONO: an AK4191 modulator with an AK4499 converter PER CHANNEL, as the maker's table says twice - « Left Channel: AK4191+AK4499 », « Right Channel: AK4191+AK4499 ». Four AKM parts in two roles. The third record in this catalogue on the AK4191+AK4499 pairing, after gustard/a26 and eversolo/dmp-a8, and the clearest argument yet that a chip model needs a role AND a count per part: « AKM » says nothing about whether a modulator is shared or doubled.

_i2s_and_bluetooth_named_without_figures: The table lists « 8-Mode IIS Digital Audio Input » and a Bluetooth input with its codecs, and gives a rate for neither. Same gap as fiio/k7: an input this catalogue cannot record as existing without also inventing a ceiling for it. Nothing is asserted for i2s or bluetooth.
_one_row_for_two_inputs: « Optical / Coaxial » is a single row covering both, so both are recorded from it. The source does name both, which is what source_names_subject is about.
